reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rule's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; absence of any non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant therefore satisfies the preferred position rather than constituting a 'missing' clause.

Cited paragraphs (p0035 General Manager/liaison, p0061 no joint venture) contain no solicitation, employment or inducement restriction, and the rationale documents targeted searches for 'solicit', 'hire', 'employ or engage', 'induce' and 'personnel' across the operative sections.
No redline and no counterparty comment were produced, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is byte-identical to the original.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artefacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not indicate an error.
Rationale correctly defers the Section 6 exclusivity covenants to the separate exclusivity rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
